skill.name: review-work
skill.description: Request a SpecStream price quote for an exact compiled request without starting a job or spending your balance.
skill.summary: Review the scope, conditions, maximum price, and expiry of a SpecStream quote.
skill.author: specstream

security_audit.summary: The skill sends quote parameters and applicable request or project identifiers to the configured SpecStream MCP service. The backticks are Markdown formatting, and the balance lookup is not system reconnaissance. No evidence of prompt injection or unauthorized spending was found in the skill text.

remediation.issue: Quote requests cross an external service boundary.
remediation.suggestion: Tell users which request identifiers are sent to SpecStream. Use only the authorized MCP configuration and omit identifiers that do not apply.

content.value_statement: The maximum cost of a SpecStream request can be unclear before you run it. Get a quote with its scope, conditions, and expiry without starting a job.
actual_capabilities: Requests a price quote using the compiled request hash and selected operation.
Includes the desired result count, useful minimum, and any applicable original identifier.
Uses the appropriate operation for more results, additional facts, or rechecking.
Reports the quote scope, conditions, maximum price, and expiry in plain text.
Reads the SpecStream capacity balance separately from spending approval.
limitations: Requires access to the configured SpecStream MCP server and a hash from an already compiled request.
A quote lasts 30 minutes and does not guarantee that results will match.
Quoting does not start a job, spend capacity, or grant spending approval.
Plans and top-ups are managed in the SpecStream account, not in chat.

use_cases.title: Price more results
use_cases.description: Check the maximum price for extending an existing search before deciding whether to proceed.

use_cases.title: Price additional facts
use_cases.description: Review the cost of adding facts to existing results without starting the work.

use_cases.title: Review a refresh budget
use_cases.description: Check the price to recheck existing results and view the balance separately.

prompt_templates.title: Get a quote
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: You already have a compiled request.
prompt_templates.prompt: Quote my compiled request for 10 results, with a useful minimum of 5. Show the scope, conditions, maximum price, and expiry. Do not start a job.

prompt_templates.title: Quote more results
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: You want to extend an existing search.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the compiled hash and original find ID to quote 20 more results, with a useful minimum of 10. Do not approve or run the work.

prompt_templates.title: Quote additional facts
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: You want to enrich existing results.
prompt_templates.prompt: Quote adding the facts in my compiled request for 10 results, with a useful minimum of 5. Use the applicable original ID and report the pricing conditions.

prompt_templates.title: Review refresh cost and balance
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: You need both a refresh quote and a capacity check.
prompt_templates.prompt: Quote rechecking 30 results, with a useful minimum of 15. Use the compiled hash and applicable original ID. Show the balance separately and do not approve spending.

output_examples.input: Quote two more results for an existing search. One result is the useful minimum.
output_examples.output: Scope: Up to two more results, with a useful minimum of one. Conditions: 15 cents per result, no contact add-ons, and no charge if nothing matches. Maximum price: $0.30. Expires at 16:00 UTC. No job was started.

output_examples.input: Quote a refresh for one existing result and show the balance separately.
output_examples.output: Scope: Recheck one result, with one as the useful minimum. Conditions: 5 cents per result and no charge if nothing matches. Maximum price: $0.05. Expires at 16:20 UTC. Capacity balance: $4.00. The balance is not approval to spend.

best_practices: Use the hash from the exact compiled request you want to price.
Provide the useful minimum and any applicable original identifier.
Review the maximum, conditions, and expiry before considering a separate approval.
anti_patterns: Using the balance as permission to spend.
Copying the quote maximum into an approval without user authorization or an existing bounded task that permits it.
Relying on an expired quote after the 30-minute window.

faq.question: Does requesting a quote start a job?
faq.answer: No. It returns a price without starting a job or spending your balance.

faq.question: What do I need before requesting a quote?
faq.answer: You need the compiled request hash, operation, desired result count, and useful minimum. Include the original find, project, or revision ID when it applies.

faq.question: How long does the quote last?
faq.answer: The quote lasts 30 minutes. Check the expiry before relying on the price.

faq.question: How are results and contact details priced?
faq.answer: Results cost 5 cents, 15 cents, or $1 each. A person's email adds 5 cents and a phone number adds 15 cents. Nothing is charged if nothing matches.

faq.question: Does my balance authorize spending?
faq.answer: No. The balance only shows available capacity. A quote does not grant spending approval.

faq.question: Where do I manage my plan or add capacity?
faq.answer: Manage plans and top-ups in your SpecStream account, not in chat.
